title_en: Liquidation: who pressed the forced-close button?
title_zh: 爆仓：谁按下了强制平仓按钮？
goal_en: Understand liquidation triggers, the mark price and maintenance requirements, without using inverse leverage as an exact formula.
goal_zh: 理解强平触发、标记价格与维持要求，不使用倒数杠杆当准确公式。

shots.visual_en: Sam watches the last traded price while the system flashes a liquidation warning beside it.
shots.visual_zh: 小白盯着最新成交价，旁边系统发出强平警告。

lines.en: The price I'm watching hasn't got there. Why is the alarm going off?
lines.zh: 我看的价格还没到，为什么已经报警了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E23' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第23集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Liquidation: who pressed the forced-close button?
onscreen_text_zh: 爆仓：谁按下了强制平仓按钮？

shots.visual_en: Three separate lines: last traded price, mark price, teaching risk line. Clearly labelled, not to be mixed.
shots.visual_zh: 三条线分开：最新成交价、标记价格、教学风险线；明确不要混用。

lines.en: The last traded price isn't always the price used to judge liquidation. Many perpetuals assess risk using a mark price and margin rules. Check which rules your platform actually uses.
lines.zh: 最新成交价不一定是强平判断采用的价格。许多永续产品会依据标记价格及保证金规则评估风险；你要看平台真正采用哪套规则。

shots.visual_en: Linear isolated teaching model: notional 1,000, margin 100; as price moves against the position, equity shrinks.
shots.visual_zh: 线性逐仓教学模型：名义仓位1000、保证金100；价格不利，权益减少。

lines.en: When the price moves against the position, losses eat into equity. Near the maintenance requirement, the system may cancel orders, reduce the position or force-close it. It won't necessarily wait for your OK.
lines.zh: 价格对仓位不利时，损失侵蚀权益。接近维持要求后，系统可能先撤销挂单、减仓或进行强制平仓，不会等你同意才一定行动。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching model · not any exchange's real rules
onscreen_text_zh: 教学模型 · 非任何交易所真实规则

shots.visual_en: Camera holds on 'Equity still above zero, can still trigger'. The exact formula is moved to an expandable section below the video on the course page.
shots.visual_zh: 镜头突出“权益尚大于零，仍可能触发”，具体公式移到课程下方展开。

lines.en: Liquidation usually means this forced-close risk event, not your phone's button breaking. The real trigger depends on fees, maintenance margin, margin mode and more. 10x doesn't mean exactly a 10% drop.
lines.zh: 爆仓通常指这种强制平仓风险事件，不是简单的手机按钮失灵。实际触发还受到费用、维持保证金、仓位模式等影响，不是十倍一定正好跌百分之十。

shots.visual_en: Simulated path: price falls and triggers risk handling, then rises; the original position is already closed and doesn't come back.
shots.visual_zh: 模拟轨迹先下跌触发风险处置，再上涨；原仓位已经被关闭，不自动复活。

lines.en: It went back up later. Can I just wait for it to come back?
lines.zh: 后来涨回来了，我还能等回来吗？

lines.en: A closed position doesn't come back on its own. A drop and then a rise can end very differently for a leveraged position and for plain spot you just held.
lines.zh: 已经关闭的仓位不会自动恢复。先下跌再上涨，对杠杆仓位和一直持有普通现货，可能是不同结果。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'If the price ends back where it started, are you guaranteed not to be liquidated along the way?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：价格最终回到原点，是否保证中途不会被强平？

lines.en: It's not just the destination. It's whether you can survive the path.
lines.zh: 不仅看终点，还要看沿途能不能承受。

onscreen_text_en: Back to start = no liquidation?  NOT GUARANTEED
onscreen_text_zh: 回到原点 = 不会强平？ 不保证

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: Price barely moved, and you didn't close, but your balance dropped. The final episode is next.
lines.zh: 价格没怎么动、也没平仓，余额却少了。下一集：最后一关。

onscreen_text_en: Price barely moved, and you didn't close, but your balance dropped. The final episode is next.
onscreen_text_zh: 价格没怎么动、也没平仓，余额却少了。下一集：最后一关。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: Price barely moved, and you didn't close, but your balance dropped. The final episode is next.
end_hook.zh: 价格没怎么动、也没平仓，余额却少了。下一集：最后一关。

page_cta.line_en: Play the same fall-then-rise path for spot and for a simplified isolated contract in the simulator below.
page_cta.line_zh: 在下方模拟器里，用同一段先跌后涨行情对比普通现货和简化逐仓合约。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Play the same virtual drop-then-rise market, and watch plain spot and a simplified isolated contract separately.
exercise.task_zh: 播放同一段先跌后涨的虚拟行情，分别观察普通现货和简化逐仓合约。
exercise.answer_en: The path matters. A contract liquidated midway isn't restored by a later rebound.
exercise.answer_zh: 路径风险重要；合约中途强平后不会因后续反弹自动恢复仓位。

Futures examples are USDT-margined linear perpetuals only; never mix in coin-margined, options or delivery formulas ｜ 合约示例限USDT计价线性永续，不混入币本位、期权和交割合约公式
Futures episode: no conversion card, no partner name, no invite code, no 'open position' button; page CTA = none ｜ 合约集：不放转化卡、不出现合作平台名和邀请码、不画“开仓”按钮；网页CTA为none
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
